evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp and net message handling paths to decouple message processing from block activation.
rationale: Decouples block validation from the P2P message thread and removes cs_main requirements from peer block download tracking and compact block reconstruction. Benchmarks demonstrate a 98% reduction in PING/PONG latency (41.8 ms to 0.77 ms) and a 32–45% drop in block-serving latency during IBD.
